text: At its meeting on April 24, 2025, the Toronto Parking Authority - Audit and Risk Management Committee considered Item PR9.5 and made recommendations to the Board of Directors of the Toronto Parking Authority. Summary from the report (April 2, 2025) from the President, Toronto Parking Authority: As North America's largest municipally-owned commercial parking operator with ample competition in the off-street parking arena, Toronto Parking Authority (TPA) uses rate setting or pricing as a tool to respond to evolving consumer behaviour and remain competitive while continuing to meet its mandate to provide short-stay, high turnover parking. Toronto Parking Authority's approach to rate setting at its off-street parking facilities is guided by Toronto Parking Authority Policy Resolution 2-1: Parking Rates - Off-Street Facilities. Under the current framework, Management carries out a…

The Board of Directors of the Toronto Parking Authority: 1. Approved the amendments to Toronto Parking Authority Policy Resolution 2-1 - Parking Rates - Off-Street Facilities in Revised Attachment 1 to the report (April 2, 2025) from the President, Toronto Parking Authority, and direct the President, Toronto Parking Authority, to enact this Policy Resolution, as amended. 2. Approved the amendments to Toronto Parking Authority Policy Resolution 2-3 - Monthly Permits in Revised Attachment 2 to the report (April 2, 2025) from the President, Toronto Parking Authority.
